title: Tribe Treasury, Tribe Boss & Emblems
message:
Tribes level 3+ get a shared **Treasury**: deposit money or gems (it can't be withdrawn), then officers propose upgrades and members vote. Buy boosts, member slots, a War Banner (+10% tribe XP), extra contract rerolls and more.

Tribes level 10+ face a **Tribe Boss** every week: hunt, kill mythics and finish quests to damage it, and everyone who helps gets a crate.

Pick a tribe **emblem and banner colour** from the new Emblems tab in `/tribe`.

Also: daily and weekly leaderboards now count everything you earn since the period started, and every update now has a version number (YY.MM.DD.N) in `/update`.

title: Mythic fights are MUCH harder
message:
Spamming Kick or Punch will no longer win you a mythic fight, and Shoot is no longer a guaranteed win.

- Mythic creatures have far more HP and hit more accurately
- A **missed Kick now costs you HP**, and you're more likely to fall and eat a free hit
- **Shooting** leaves you exposed to its counterattack, and volleys miss more often
- **Defend** only heals the first 3 times in a fight, so you can't stall
- Cornered mythics (under 30% HP) hit harder
- Losing costs more cash and fleeing is less reliable

Arrive with full HP, bring healing, and pick your moments.

title: New setting: Hunt messages
message:
Choose how the **Hunt** button behaves in `/settings` → **New Message Per Hunt**.

- **OFF** (default): Hunt updates the same message in place
- **ON**: every Hunt posts a fresh message and keeps the old ones, so you can scroll back through your catches

`/hunt` always posts a new message.

title: Mythic art + Shard Charm
message:
- **Mythic fights** now show the creature's art big in the top right of the fight and result screens
- **Crate Charm** is now **Shard Charm** — it only ever boosted shard drops, so the name finally says so. Your upgrades carried over
- New `/giveaway` command group: giveaways, loot drops, number guesses and hunt races — watch your server for them

title: Mythic rebalance, vote reminder & a better intro
message:
- **Mythic fights are cheaper and pay more:** each Shoot now uses **10 rounds** instead of 100, kills pay about **double** the bounty and **triple** XP, and a win **patches you up (+35% HP)** so you don't need a medkit after every fight. Losing costs a little less cash again too
- **`/daily` now reminds you to vote** — when your vote reward is ready you get a Vote button and a Claim button right there
- **New players get a real intro:** it now explains what Idle Hunter is, with a Quick Tour of hunting, mythicals, idle income and tribes

title: Every casino game is its own command
message:
Search for the game you want and it's right there:

`/gamble blackjack` · `/gamble coinflip` · `/gamble slots` · `/gamble roulette` · `/gamble rps` · `/gamble dice` · `/gamble highlow`

`/gamble menu` still opens the hub with every game in one dropdown.

title: Text commands, and Admin's Day Off tuned
message:
- **Type commands instead of using slash:** start a message with `ih ` — `ih hunt`, `ih daily`, `ih bj`, `ih cf`, `ih lb`, `ih tribe`, `ih vote`… Send just `ih` for the full cheat sheet. Everything works exactly like the slash version, buttons included
- **Admin's Day Off is less extreme:** the shop discount is now **25% off ammo, healing & items** (was 50% off everything) — tools, vehicles and 💎 prices are no longer discounted, and the welcome bonus is smaller
- **Wild animal fights show the animal's art** big in the top right, like Mythicals
- **Hunting from an event announcement now posts publicly** in the channel, and can open fights and tracking properly

title: /balance, a cleaner /craft, and add the bot to your account
message:
- **New `/balance`** (or `ih bal`): your money and gems at a glance, plus your bag's value, shards, crystals and crates — with Sell All, Daily and Shop buttons. Add a name to check someone else's
- **`/craft` has been reorganised:** a one-line summary up top, then one clear section per tab — Fuse Crystals (with your shards and the forge queue), Crates, and Items
- **`/invite` now has "Add to Account":** install the bot to *yourself* and use every command in any server or DM, without adding it to a server

title: Lifetime animals leaderboard
message:
- **New leaderboard: Lifetime Animals Caught.** Every animal you catch now counts towards your whole account, and prestiging or resetting never wipes it
- **"Total Animals Caught" is now your current run** (since your last prestige), so you can race people on both boards — pick either one in `/leaderboard` → Sort by stat
- Your **Statistics** page shows both numbers. Lifetime starts from your current run for existing players, and counts every catch from now on

title: Profile bio and Profile Editor
message:
- **Profile bios:** write a short bio (150 characters) that shows on your `/profile`
- **Choose what your profile shows:** pick from your money, gear, tribe, badges, boosts, camp and more with a multi-select — hidden sections are hidden for everyone who views you
- **Both live behind a new setting,** `/settings` → **Profile Editor** (off by default). Turn it on and your own profile gets an *Edit Bio* button and the picker

title: Bigger vote rewards, a kinder Scratch Pad, and more forge slots
message:
- **`/vote` rewards buffed:** an **Epic Crate** instead of a Rare Crate, more than **3× the cash** it used to pay, and **5 gems** on every vote — plus the Scratch Pad, every 12h
- **Scratch Pad is easier:** one column removed, so it's **12 panels instead of 16** with the same 5 prizes and 3 scratches
- **Scratch Pad prizes are bigger:** more cash, more gems, a stronger Luck boost — and new **Rare, Epic and even Legendary Crates**, plus a cash jackpot
- **Forge slots grow with your level:** everyone starts with 20, then **+5 every 50 levels** up to 120 at level 1000. `/craft` shows how many you have and when the next ones unlock
-# Every vote helps more hunters find the bot — thank you!

title: More custom icons across the game
message:
- **Mythic fights:** Punch, Kick, Taunt and Flee now use the custom icon art on their buttons and in the fight log
- **Tracking:** the Watch and Push choices and the trail scenes show custom icons
- **World conditions:** Heavy Rain, Clear Skies and Aurora have their own art
- **Tribes:** expeditions, routes, recruits and the Perks button got custom icons too
-# Purely visual — nothing about gameplay or rewards changed.

title: Tribes are teams now: Hunting Parties, Territory and a Weekly Chest
message:
- **Hunting Parties:** hunt the same biome as tribemates within 30 minutes of each other — nobody has to be online at once. **2 hunters** is a Duo, **3** a Hunting Party, **5** a Full Party, each with better odds on rare and mythic finds
- **Territory:** every biome has an outpost. Hunting and mythic kills there earn your tribe influence; at the weekly reset the tribe with the most influence **per active hunter** holds it for a week (+5% rare odds there and bonus tribe XP). Three busy hunters can beat twenty casual ones
- **Weekly Chest:** everything you do for the tribe now counts as contribution. Reach Bronze, Silver or Gold by the weekly reset and you get a crate — and tribe milestones (contracts, boss, expedition, outpost, party hunts) upgrade every chest
- **Contracts pay you personally:** finish one and every participant gets a crate, not just tribe XP
- **Built for small tribes:** contracts and bosses now scale from a 3-hunter tribe, expeditions need just 2 members and unlock at Tribe Level 4, and the boss arrives at Level 5 (was 8 and 10)
- **Treasury:** two new shared upgrades — **Scout Network** (wider party window) and **Outpost Garrison** (more influence)
-# Find it all under `/tribe` → Hunting Party, Territory and Weekly Chest.

title: Fights have teeth, vehicles work, and legendaries are legendary
message:
- **No more free healing mid-fight:** `/use` is blocked during an encounter — use the new **Heal** button, which costs your turn (mythic fights get one too). The shop is closed while you're being hunted
- **Your HP doesn't regenerate during a fight,** and a fight left unanswered for 10 minutes simply ends (no reward, no penalty)
- **Running isn't free:** a failed mythic escape costs HP, and fleeing an animal can earn you a parting strike (never a knockout). Smoke Bombs still get you out clean
- **Danger animals scale with the region** — a Celestial Peaks legendary is far tougher than a village one — and aggressive rares can occasionally pick a fight too
- **Won fights pay 4.5× (was 10×).** After a knockout, dangerous animals keep their distance for 5 minutes
- **Healing items cost a little more**
- **Vehicle bug fixed:** the hunt cooldown from vehicles now actually applies (Hovercraft = 1s hunts, not 3s)
- **Finished crates now drop per hunt, not per animal** (5%, up to 8% with top gear), and **legendary animals are properly rare** in late regions
-# Numbers are first-pass — tell us how it feels.

title: Casino limits are back, and the house wins a little
message:
- **Max bet is back:** it scales with how far you've progressed (and with your balance, so big holders can still play), and a single wager can no longer win more than a capped amount
- **Coinflip now pays 1.9×** and **Rock Paper Scissors 1.85×** (ties still refund) — about a 95% return, like the other games
-# Set your bet in any game to see your current maximum.

title: The Hollow Star: a season-long story, 15 new events and a daily theme
message:
A star fell on the Wilds, and it didn't go out. **Events now tell one story** — *The Hollow Star* — and every event is a chapter you can play, unlock and re-read in your **Chronicle** (`/events` → Chronicle, or `/info` → Story).
- **15 quest events:** Meteor Shower, The Great Fog, **Admin Error 404**, The Lost Cartographer, Thunderstorm Survival, Great Migration, Night Watch, Tracks of the Unknown, Wanted, The Impostor Hunter, Campfire Festival, Hunter's Tournament, Mysterious Supply Crate, **Tribe Relay** and **Biome Conquest**
- **Events no longer change prices or income.** Admin's Day Off (half-price, ×2 everything) is retired in favour of challenges, puzzles and community goals. Every event has a **fixed reward budget** and pays in **cosmetics** — titles, badges and profile **keepsakes** — plus at most one capped crate
- **Admin Error 404** keeps the Day Off's chaos without the cheat code: absurd bug-hunt objectives, fake errors, a glitch badge. Nothing is cheaper and nothing pays double
- **A daily theme every weekday:** 🧭 Explorer's Monday (travel takes half the time) · 🎯 Training Tuesday (+10% hunt XP on your first 40 hunts) · ⚒️ Workshop Wednesday (-20% craft time on 5 crafts) · 🤝 Tribe Thursday (+25% contract tribe XP, capped) · 🎯 **Most Wanted Friday** (name the hidden region — the first three are remembered) · 👹 **Saturday Monster Rampage** (a shared world boss: clear its minions, then take it down) · 🏕️ Recovery Sunday (2× HP regen and one free full heal)
- **Tribe events are built for small tribes:** the Relay and Conquest both work with just two or three active members
-# `/events` has the live event and today's theme; `/info` has a full guide to every event and the whole story.

title: /fight: Trail Standoff — a hide-and-seek duel
message:
Challenge another hunter to a **Trail Standoff** with `/fight challenge`.
- **Six rounds, roles swap every round.** The prey secretly picks a hiding spot; the hunter secretly picks a spot to search and a method — **Sharpshot** (exact spot, 3 points) or **Sweep** (that spot and the next, 1 point). A prey that isn't found scores 1
- **No gear, no luck of the draw** — you can't reuse the same spot two rounds in a row, so reading your rival is everything. Ties go to sudden death
- **Optional stake:** both put it up, the winner takes the pot minus a **10% toll that is burned**. Capped to the lower of your two casino limits, level 5+, up to 8 duels a day and 2 per pair
- `/fight stats`, `/fight leaderboard` (rating) and `/fight rules`. Duel titles unlock at 10 / 25 / 60 wins
-# If the bot restarts mid-duel, every stake is refunded.

title: Hunting Camp tuning: no lost progress, fairer Camp Rations
message:
- **No more lost production:** the leftover fraction of a catch is kept every time you check, upgrade or collect, so your camp pays what it earns however often you look
- **Camp Rations** now feed the next **15 animals** you collect (+25% money and XP) instead of a whole haul. Using more rations **stacks** them (up to 45) instead of wasting them, and they cost a little more
- **Bonus items from the camp** now depend on how big the haul is, not how many times you click Collect
- **Passive hunting doesn't use ammo, so your equipped ammo's bonuses no longer apply to camp hauls**
- **Your camp's biome needs the right tool tier** all the time, not only when you pick it — swap to a weaker tool and it falls back to the Village
- **The camp's faster HP recovery** now applies once you've stopped hunting for 5 minutes, instead of making you heal twice as fast while you're out in the field

title: Bets are back
message:
- **Betting limits are back** — your max bet scales with how far you've progressed, and a single wager can only win so much
- Coinflip and Rock Paper Scissors **pay 2× again**; the odds are just a little in the house's favour now (you'll see them on the game screens)

title: Camp trophy timing
message: - **Camp production trophies** (like Coarse Yowie Hair) now only boost the time they're actually running — using one no longer back-pays hours you'd already waited, and one that runs out mid-wait only counts for the part it covered
